extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings ongoing at the Family Court at Birmingham
extracted.summary: A solicitor seeks around £15,500 to fund his client's financial remedy proceedings in Birmingham, where matrimonial assets are said to be about £258,500.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have logged for review. To take this further we would need details of the next hearing or key dates in the proceedings, a breakdown of the estimated costs to conclusion, and confirmation of the nature and ownership of the assets in dispute, including any existing charges on the family home. It would also help to have your client's details and confirmation of your firm's involvement through to conclusion. A member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided. Nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding can be offered or on what basis.
